applies_to.notes: Only Claude Code CLI 2.1.296. Source M003 is the first-party documented named register entry; additional accepted direct function/const forms and rejected factory/alias forms are independently reproduced with Mac CLI strict and offline mock checks. No user Chat-origin code was executed.

evidence.notes: Reviewed official M003 Files section documents a named `register(on)` entry and default export is not the equivalent. Independently executed seven assistant-authored synthetic Mod variants on native Mac Claude Code CLI 2.1.296 with both `plugin validate --strict` and `plugin test`; direct named declaration, const arrow/function, async arrow and local const export alias pass, while exported factory-call initializer and indirect variable assignment both fail. These additional syntactic details are native observations rather than guarantees individually stated by the official page; private downloaded model-origin artifact was never executed.

statement: Claude Code CLI 2.1.296 的 Mods `hooks/register.js` 模块必须提供静态可发现的具名 `register(on)` 函数入口。官方标准示例 `export function register(on)` 已通过原生严格验证和离线模拟测试；同一目标 CLI 的独立隔离合成测试也接受 `export const register = (on) => {}`、`export const register = function(on) {}`、`export const register = async (on) => {}`，以及先定义 `const register = (on) => {}` 再 `export { register }` 的形式。相反，在该 CLI 下 `export const register = createRegister()` 和`const fn = (on) => {}; export const register = fn` 这样的间接初始化形式，即使最终值可能是函数，`claude plugin validate --strict <mod-directory>` 仍会拒绝，且 `claude plugin test <mod-directory>` 无法加载对应 Hook。`export default function register({ on })` 不是等价的具名入口。以上是 CLI 2.1.296 本机特定语法的有限观察，不应推广到未测试的其它间接导出、TypeScript 编译产物或未来版本。
subject: mods.types.static-discoverable-registration-export
